description: This bar chart, from the paper “Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models,” illustrates the percentage point difference in performance between two multilingual transformer models, mBERT (light blue bars) and XLM-R (dark blue bars), across three distinct model configurations along the horizontal axis: “hidden:[50], linear,” “hidden:[100], ReLU,” and “hidden:[50, 50], ReLU.” The vertical axis, labeled “% point difference,” is scaled linearly from -0.2 to +0.2, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. For each configuration, two bars are displayed side-by-side, representing the respective model’s performance difference. In the “hidden:[50], linear” configuration, the mBERT bar extends downward to approximately -0.15, while the XLM-R bar extends downward to approximately -0.05. In the “hidden:[100], ReLU” configuration, the mBERT bar extends downward to approximately -0.12, and the XLM-R bar extends upward to approximately +0.03. In the “hidden:[50, 50], ReLU” configuration, the mBERT bar extends downward to approximately -0.18, and the XLM-R bar extends downward to approximately -0.15. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the model configurations as listed on the x-axis. The chart includes a legend in the top-right corner that associates the light blue color with mBERT and the dark blue color with XLM-R.
